project_name: Smithfield Gateway potential data center prospect
status_detail: Monroe County's 2024 audit notes DEPG Mosier Associates' Smithfield Gateway mixed-use project was negotiating with several prospects including a hotel and a data center; no approval, operator, capacity, or firm data-center filing found during county/news sweep.
notes: Also found Monroe County Planning Commission agenda items for Mount Pocono, Eldred Township, and Pocono Township data-center zoning amendments/guide, but no additional specific project record.

aliases: former Cleveland-Cliffs steel mill data center
status_detail: Plymouth Township received a Zoning Hearing Board application seeking special exception approval for a data center at the former steel mill site at 900 Conshohocken Road; local news reports the proposal as roughly 2 million square feet and the zoning case was still continuing in August 2026.
notes: Application followed an earlier withdrawn submission. Capacity not disclosed in accessible township/news materials.

project_name: Renaissance Park and Innovation Data Center Campus
aliases: King of Prussia data center campus
status_detail: Upper Merion Planning Commission materials and news describe five proposed data-center sites totaling more than 4.5 million square feet in King of Prussia; Business Insider reported up to 900 MW. Planning commission review in 2026 included non-recommendations/deferrals for some sites, so final approvals remain unresolved.
notes: Official minutes list applications including 2201/2301/2501/2701/2901 Renaissance Blvd, 411 Swedeland Road, and 600 River Road; public sources also cite 2100 Renaissance Road and 3200 Horizon Drive.

project_name: Talen Energy Montour County data center rezoning
city: Washingtonville / Derry Township / Anthony Township area
status_detail: Montour County commissioners unanimously denied Talen Energy's request to rezone roughly 800 acres from agricultural to industrial for a data-center-enabled development in February 2026; later county activity focused on adopting data-center zoning rules.
notes: News reports say Talen indicated it would continue exploring a path forward after the rezoning denial; current county action found was ordinance/regulatory, not project approval.

project_name: Prologis Lehigh Valley East 16 Data Center Conversion
status_detail: Allen Township supervisors unanimously approved a final plan amendment in March 2026 to convert Prologis' 1,011,808-square-foot warehouse at 2500 Liberty Drive into a data center; reports describe closed-loop cooling and a private substation funded by Prologis.
notes: Local news indicates this may be the first Lehigh Valley hyperscale data center to proceed; exact IT load not disclosed.

project_name: Upper Mount Bethel data center campus
aliases: Slate Belt Holdings data center campus
city: Upper Mount Bethel Township / Mount Bethel
developer: Slate Belt Holdings LLC; Talen Energy; River Pointe Logistics
status_detail: Slate Belt Holdings LLC, a partnership involving Talen Energy and the River Pointe Logistics team, is seeking to develop a campus outside Bangor/Upper Mount Bethel Township with up to 23 buildings of about 201,500 square feet each and a 480 MW on-site substation; reports say the developers are challenging township zoning ordinances.
notes: Site was previously associated with River Pointe Commerce Center and reported prior Amazon interest. Lower Mount Bethel official site was checked because Talen's nearby Lower Mount Bethel power plant is referenced in reporting.

County/municipal/news search found discussion of data centers and ordinance interest, including a December 2025 local-news item about a commissioner calling data centers a possible second Industrial Revolution, but no concrete Northumberland County project, site plan, developer filing, or approval found.

aliases: MRP Industrial Watts Township data center
status_detail: MRP Industrial may build a data center campus instead of its prior Susquehanna Crossings warehouse project on a 288-acre parcel in Watts Township. Public summaries describe ten 138,000-square-foot data center buildings; township held data-center ordinance hearings in 2026 and no final project approval was found.
notes: Aterio summary says submitted plans total 1.48 million square feet on 288 acres; DCD says the project remains preliminary with no approvals obtained as of May 2026.

status_detail: Provider page lists a 72,000-square-foot Tier III carrier-neutral colocation data center at 1500 Spring Garden St., Suite 520, Philadelphia.
notes: Operational colocation facility; IT load not disclosed on source page.

status_detail: Equinix lists Philadelphia colocation data centers serving enterprises and network providers; facility-level capacity not captured from public page in this quick county sweep.
notes: Provider page confirms operating Philadelphia market data centers but does not expose project construction details in search-accessible text.

status_detail: Netrality operates the 401 North Broad carrier-hotel/data-center property in Philadelphia; included as an operating data-center asset found during Philadelphia county sweep.
notes: DataCenterMap also lists Philadelphia facilities but is used only as a secondary tracker here.

status_detail: Newmark marketing material describes 2000 Kubach Road as a purpose-built two-story data center constructed in 1993 and renovated in 2003, with 124,190 gross square feet including 76,000 square feet of data center space and 40,000 square feet of raised-floor/critical computing area.
notes: Classified as operational/available data-center real estate based on broker material; current operator was not identified in quick sweep.
County website/planning and news search did not identify a concrete Pike County data center project. Big Bass Lake/Clifton-Covington results appear to be in Lackawanna/Wayne County, not Pike County.

Checked Potter County official site and local/news searches for Coudersport/Potter County data center or server farm. Found social-media opposition/concern and generic service pages, but no reliable project filing, developer, approval, or official project record.

status_detail: Pennsylvania Office of Transformation and Opportunity Fast Track page lists Kline Township Data Center Development in Schuylkill County with fast-track acceptance on May 22, 2025 and status in progress; Baxtel reports Amazon Data Services purchased a 346-acre Kline Township property in 2025 for $178 million.
notes: Capacity not disclosed in official fast-track page snippet; local reporting says AWS representatives discussed the planned Kline Township project.

project_name: Butler Township Nebius data center complex
status_detail: Local reporting indicates work has begun on an AI data-center complex in Butler Township, Schuylkill County, described as six buildings with a 1.2 GW power plant; WNEP reported Nebius held an open house while the site was being prepared.
notes: The 1.2 GW and six-building details were available via local-news/social preview; treat capacity as reported until confirmed in primary permits.
